user.title: Connect Artifact
user.description: Artifact must already be running in Docker. Enter the API and web interface addresses reachable from Home Assistant and your browser.

data_description.url: Base address of the API, without /health.
data_description.web_url: Address opened by the Visit link on the Artifact device.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Artifact
reconfigure.description: Change the addresses of the Artifact API and web interface.

error.invalid_url: Enter valid HTTP(S) URLs without credentials, query parameters or fragments.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the API. Check that Artifact is running and Home Assistant can reach its address.
error.invalid_response: This address did not return Artifact's health response. Check the API address and port (normally 8000).

abort.already_configured: This Artifact server is already configured.
